title: adjudicate canonical-JSON SHA-256 golden vectors
description: Cross-runtime vectors pinning the RFC 8785 (JCS) + SHA-256 algorithm documented in canonical-json-hash.md. Any external runtime (Rust, Go, Python, Java, browser-JS) that claims interop with @adjudicate/core MUST produce the listed hash for each input. These vectors are derived from packages/core/tests/hash-golden-vectors.test.ts and the audit subset vectors are derived from packages/core/scripts/compute-vectors.ts. Any change here REQUIRES the same change in both producers.

vectors.label: v1-minimal-canonical-envelope
vectors.notes: the baseline shape — published in canonical-json-hash.md

vectors.label: v2-key-order-independence
vectors.notes: key-order independence — the canonicalization sorts keys; this hash MUST equal v1 byte-for-byte

vectors.label: v3-trusted-system-variant
vectors.notes: taint and principal both feed the recipe — TRUSTED+system MUST hash differently from UNTRUSTED+llm with same kind/payload/nonce

vectors.label: v4-empty-payload-system-taint
vectors.notes: {} is a valid payload — not equivalent to undefined or null

vectors.label: v5-utf8-nested
vectors.notes: RFC 8785 §3.3 mandates literal UTF-8 in strings, not \uXXXX escapes — 'café' must hash with bytes caf-c3-a9, not caf-005c-u00e9

vectors.label: v6-null-preserved-undefined-omitted
vectors.notes: {reason: null} preserves the null; {optional: undefined} omits the key entirely — see canonical-json-hash.md §2.2

vectors.label: v7-large-nested-array
vectors.notes: stresses 32-element nested-object arrays — order MUST be preserved

vectors.label: v8-numeric-edge
vectors.notes: JCS numeric serialization — 100.0 → '100', 0.01 → '0.01', 1e-7 → '1e-7'. Implementations using float-printers other than ES2015 will diverge here

vectors.label: v9-deeply-nested-object
vectors.notes: recursive key sort — every nested object's keys are sorted, not just top-level

vectors.label: v10-resource-refs-dropped
vectors.notes: 031 drop-safety baseline — the SAME envelope WITHOUT resourceRefs. An envelope built with resourceRefs absent (or explicitly undefined) MUST canonical-drop the key, so this hash equals what every pre-031 / post-041 implementation already produces for a no-refs envelope. The v11 vector below is this object PLUS a resourceRefs map; it MUST differ.

vectors.label: v11-resource-refs-bound
vectors.notes: 031 v3 — resourceRefs PRESENT is bound into the hash (§D #4: the LLM cannot post-hoc flip the declared owner). Same envelope as v10 plus resourceRefs {account, owner}; MUST hash differently from v10. resourceRefs keys are canonicalized (recursive lexicographic sort) like any object. A no-refs envelope drops the key entirely (see v10).

vectors.label: v12-actor-role-dropped
vectors.notes: WS7 drop-safety baseline — the SAME envelope WITHOUT actor.role. An envelope built with role absent (or explicitly undefined) MUST canonical-drop the key, so this hash equals what every pre-WS7 implementation already produces for a role-free envelope. The v13 vector below is this object PLUS actor.role; it MUST differ.

vectors.label: v13-actor-role-bound
vectors.notes: WS7 — actor.role PRESENT is bound into the hash (a post-decision role swap is tamper-evident; a staff-band envelope cannot be re-labeled). Same envelope as v12 plus actor.role "MANAGER"; MUST hash differently from v12. role is an opaque adopter-vocabulary string, canonicalized inside actor like any other key. A role-free envelope drops the key entirely (see v12).

vectors.label: audit-v4-execute
vectors.notes: Canonical AuditRecord v4 hash subset for an EXECUTE decision. The subset is the record minus {auditHash, signature}; see packages/core/src/audit.ts. Cross-runtime audit verification MUST hash this subset to the listed digest.

vectors.label: audit-v4-refuse
vectors.notes: Canonical AuditRecord v4 hash subset for a REFUSE decision. Mirrors audit-v4-execute structure; covers the refusal-code path which carries the Refusal object inside Decision.
